# Sign in designs (fixture, text description of 5 frames)

1. "Sign in": email, password, "Sign in" button, "Forgot password?" link.
2. "Sign in - loading": spinner, fields disabled.
3. "Sign in - wrong credentials": banner "Email or password is incorrect", email kept.
4. "Sign in - offline": banner "Can't connect. Check your connection and try again." and button "Try again".
5. "Home".

Not present: "Remember me" checkbox, show or hide password toggle, social sign-in. None are mentioned in requirements.
